ratings.comment: The class itself was extremely easy, though her grading is extremely particular.  Even though the class is not about grammar, she expects it to be perfect and will take off points if you make a mistake.  Other than that, if you show up to class and understand for the most part what is going on in the readings, you will do fine!

Professor Kluge is a sweet lady, but her lectures are extremely boring. Read all of the documents you're given. If you don't, you will struggle to put the detail into your exams. The exams were not tough. It doesn't take much time to read. Put time and effort into your homework assignments because they're worth 40% of your grade. Participate!

She is an absolutely awful teacher and I am not entirely sure she is qualified in her senile state to teach anything. She often goes off on random tangents that have nothing to do with the material we are learning.l.

She is an absolutely awful teacher and I am not entirely sure she is qualified in her senile state to teach anything. She often goes off on random tangents that have nothing to do with the material we are learning. Her questions for readings are absolutely ridiculous. Absolutely awful teacher and her classes are incredibly dull.
Extrememly boring lectures. She gets sidetracked a lot and jumps around. Fortunately, the tests are very easy
She knows what she is talking about (when shoe doesn't get sidetracked). She moves extremely quickly through the slides. Class is extremely dull but easy and counts toward German culture classes.
She is probably the sweetest woman you will ever meet. As long as you pay attention somewhat, and study for the exams. You will be fine! Take the class!

She's a lot of fun and is an interesting person to talk to. I'm have a considerable amount of German ethnic heritage but have never been there. She designed the class in such a way to get people excited about their family history and about Germans in Wisconsin. She was very relatable, and she was quite friendly.

Although I find this class deathly boring (history isn't really my thing though), it's very easy to get at least a B without reading the course packet. She's very nice but often gets sidetracked and forgets what she's talking about or forgets why she put something on a slide.

nicest lady ever. class is 2 exams, a paper, and a final. all are pretty easy with just memorizing some terms and examples. was a lot more interesting that i anticipated...not simply about Germans and you learn a lot about UW history. TAKE IT
Professor Kluge is a peach.  Her class is very very easy.  Exams were simple.  Low work-load, especially for 16 retros. :)  Take her class.

The only work you'll be required to do is readings.  Only two of the essays were assigned to us all semester.  She's super nice!  You can get your retros with no problem.  Tests were essay but they were also easy A's.  Highly recommended to all.

For someone whose high school german program was a joke and still managed to test into 5th semester, this was a tough course.  My speaking skills weren't very developed before, and they really haven't changed.  The classes were pretty boring, but non-workintensive, getting the retros is possible.
Didn't learn as much as I had hoped, but still quite a bit. Didn't follow the sylabus for grading, but the grading was very fair.  OK Prof.

Insanely easy! If you take 225, hope that you get into her section.  Tests were for the most part essay, but she's an easy grader. There were basically two homework assignments all semester, and they were cake. Light work load, easy tests, easy grader. I snagged my retros and an A without a problem.
